news.analysis: Allen did not attempt a single rush all game. It was not his best performance overall as a result, though he still threw for over 300 yards. He'll take on the Chiefs next on Thursday.

news.analysis: Allen and Breece Hall combined for 151 rushing yards in the close win over Los Angeles. Allen continues to see a solid workload despite sharing time with Hall, giving both running backs standalone fantasy value. He will be a flex option in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

news.contents: New York Jets running back Breece Hall has scored 11.7 and 14.8 PPR points in his two games back from a quadriceps injury that cost him five games. Seven catches supplied 93 of his 195 scrimmage yards in that span, and he drew four targets in each game. That receiving work makes him a reasonable RB2 in 12-team PPR leagues for Sunday's road game against the Los Angeles Chargers. RotoBaller ranks him RB16 for Week 11 in PPR. news.contents: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan had a big game in his team's Week 11 win over the Baltimore Ravens, recording six catches for 71 yards and a touchdown on nine targets. It was a nice bounce-back performance for the 23-year-old, who was held to just three catches for 35 yards on seven targets by the New Orleans Saints in Week 10. news.contents: Chicago Bears running back Roschon Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to return to the Week 11 game against the New Orleans Saints due to an ankle injury, the team announced. Johnson was injured in the first quarter and was carted off to Chicago's locker room after spending time in the blue medical tent. Johnson did not record any statistics before exiting the contest. Chicago's top-two running backs, D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai, are available for the Bears.
news.title: Roschon Johnson Doubtful to Return Against Saints with Ankle Injury
